info.title: Multi-Tenant Offline-First Desk Booking & Pod Allocation API
info.description:
Enterprise-grade REST API powering multi-tenant workspace management, offline-first SQLite sync,
interactive 2D SVG workstation booking, agile team pod allocations, role-scoped bulk cancellations,
and Centralized vs. Delegated governance architectures.

Employees can only cancel reservations they own or booked on proxy.
Branch administrators can cancel any reservation within their assigned branch.
Global organization administrators can cancel reservations across the entire tenant.
